Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering target_dictionary.pref_name to 'lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1' and target_dictionary.organism to 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier.
